questions.question: A 240 V heater draws 12.5 A. What is the power rating of the heater?
questions.explanation: Use P = E × I. P = 240 × 12.5 = 3,000 W. The heater is rated at 3 kW.

questions.question: In a pure resistive AC circuit, voltage and current are:
questions.explanation: In a resistive circuit, current follows voltage directly. There is no inductive or capacitive phase shift. Power factor is 1 or 100%.

questions.question: A diode is mainly used to:
questions.explanation: A diode conducts when forward biased. It blocks current when reverse biased. This makes it useful for rectification.

questions.category: D1 — Interpret plans, drawings and specifications
questions.question: A drawing note says “panel L2, circuit 14.” What does this identify?
options: The panel and circuit number supplying the load
questions.explanation: Panel and circuit notes identify the electrical source. They help with installation and troubleshooting. They also reduce the chance of working on the wrong circuit.

questions.category: H1 — Install single-phase consumer/supply services and metering equipment
questions.question: In a 120/240 V single-phase three-wire service, voltage from either line to neutral is:
questions.explanation: Each ungrounded conductor to neutral gives 120 V. Across the two ungrounded conductors gives 240 V. This is common in residential services.
